seo.title: Dose Easy — Supplement & Vitamin Tracker for iPhone
seo.description: A daily checklist for your supplements and vitamins. Add one in a sentence, check off each dose, get a reminder when one is due, and keep your streak. No accounts, no subscriptions.

hero.label: SUPPLEMENT TRACKER
hero.title: Every dose, one tap.
text: A daily checklist for your supplements and vitamins. Type “Vitamin D 2000 IU every morning” and it’s on your list. Check off each dose, get a reminder when one is due, and keep your streak going. No sign-up, no subscriptions, no data collection.

items.title: Add in a sentence
items.text: Type “Magnesium 400 mg at night” and Dose Easy fills in the name, amount, time and schedule. Or start from a list of common supplements, or set everything yourself.

items.title: Today's checklist
items.text: Your doses by morning, afternoon and evening. Tap one once you’ve taken it, touch and hold to skip it. As-needed supplements are a tap away too.

items.title: Reminders that know what's left
items.text: A notification at each dose time naming what’s due, with a button to mark it as taken. Times you’ve already covered stay quiet.

items.title: Streak and history
items.text: Your streak counts the days you took every dose. See the month at a glance, 30 days of doses, your best streak, and each supplement’s history. Forgot yesterday? Catch up in a tap.

items.title: Widgets
items.text: See what’s left today on your Home Screen and Lock Screen, and mark a dose as taken right from the widget.

items.title: Export
items.text: Share every dose you’ve marked as a CSV file, for your own records or to bring to an appointment.

items.title: Your accent
items.text: Pick one of eight accents to mark your streak. It sets the app icon too, with dark and tinted versions, and the widget.

items.title: Day or night
items.text: Follow your iPhone or pick Light or Dark. After dark, choose soft Graphite or true OLED Black.

items.title: A tracker, not advice
items.text: Dose Easy keeps track of what you take. It doesn’t recommend supplements or amounts; that’s for you, the label and your doctor.

sections.label: PRIVACY
sections.title: Your routine stays yours.
text: No analytics. No ads. No tracking. No cloud sync. Your supplements and doses live on your device and nowhere else. Zero data collection, period.
